ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Proposal Sent'), OR( AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Inquiry'), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Corporate_Event', OR( ISBLANK(Expected_Headcount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Event_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Event_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(Quoted_Price__c) ) ), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Consultation Completed'), RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Social_Event', OR( ISBLANK(Expected_Headcount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Event_Type__c)), ISBLANK(Event_Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(Quoted_Price__c) ) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cannot move to Proposal Sent. Expected Headcount, Event Type, Start Date, and Quoted Price must all be filled in.
